title: Chase and Yonas cognitive enhancement patent

tellings.quote: Enter Lockheed Martin engineers Charles Chase and Gerald Yonas with a patent called cognitive [music] enhancement using feedback.

plain: Two Lockheed Martin engineers, Charles Chase and Gerald Yonas, filed a patent called "cognitive enhancement using feedback", Michels says, placing it around 2020. He brings it up himself in an episode about a UFO book the Pentagon tried to censor, presenting it as an example of a big defence contractor working on ways to boost the human mind.
